text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting North York Community Council to authorize the installation of all-way stop control at the intersection of Bainbridge Avenue and Harlock Boulevard. The installation of all-way stop sign control is warranted and is recommended to enhance the safety for all users of this intersection, including pedestrians destined to/from the adjacent elementary school.
North York Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Bainbridge Avenue and Harlock Boulevard.
